import numpy as np
from tslearn.metrics.softdtw_variants import SoftDTW

# Ensure the distance matrix is non-negative
D = np.abs(tiny_matrix)

# Instantiate SoftDTW and perform the forward pass
sdtw = SoftDTW(D, gamma=1.0)
sdtw.compute()

# Compute the gradient w.r.t. the distance matrix D
grad_D = sdtw.grad()

# The gradient of Soft-DTW w.r.t D represents the expected alignment matrix.
# All valid alignment paths must start at (0, 0) and end at (m-1, n-1),
# so the expected visits to these cells should be exactly 1.0.
assert grad_D.shape == D.shape
assert isinstance(grad_D, np.ndarray)
assert np.isclose(grad_D[0, 0], 1.0), f"Expected 1.0 at start, got {grad_D[0, 0]}"
assert np.isclose(grad_D[-1, -1], 1.0), f"Expected 1.0 at end, got {grad_D[-1, -1]}"

print(f"__CHECK__ grad {grad_D.shape} {grad_D[-1, -1]:.1f}")
